usage: Used as a noun meaning a hobby of collecting stamps; it is usually talked about as a leisure interest, not as a physical object.
Common with verbs like "玩" or "做" when talking about having this hobby, and with words like "人士" to describe people who collect stamps.
In everyday Cantonese, this word sounds natural and general, suitable for both casual conversation and simple writing.
Learner tip: this word names the hobby itself, so it is not the same as saying "stamps" in general.
